sampleEntry.desc: This 1965 Porsche 912 Project Shell is offered at $9,800 in Diamond Bar, California. From the seller: "1965 porsche 912 early metal dash 3 gauge car,No Engine no trans,clean front clean engine bay no damage,roof is damaged .The car has all the suspension steers and rolls .No extra parts only what you see on pictures .Comes with Poa and Bill of sale it will need to repaired before you start title. Factory” Ragon Red” very early 912 ,the original vin numbers stamped and plates are there ,also vin on the top of the dash all match ." Important disclosures: the TITLE IS MISSING, the ad lists SALVAGE condition, and it has NO ENGINE — sold as a parts/project shell. Located in Diamond Bar, California.
